'''Spearhead''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="SW:GB" /> in [[3000 BBY]].<ref name="EA" />

A fortress-city, Spearhead was the headquarters of rogue [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]]. The fortress was divided between surface and submerged buildings and was said never to have fallen in the history of Gungan warfare.<ref name="SW:GB" />

The city's walls fell as it came under siege of Boss [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo's]] united [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] and the [[Bongomeken Collective]] during the [[Raid on Spearhead]]. Rogoe was killed, and Gallo built a [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|new city]] on the grounds of Spearhead to serve as a capital for the newly united Gungan people.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Spearhead appears in the third mission of the Gungan campaign in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] expansion pack [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']].
